name: Inbound lead automation
examples: inquiries and requests from potential customers (quote, booking, shipment or service requests) arriving by web form or email: capture into CRM, routing to the right person, notifications, follow-ups

name: CRM setup and integration
examples: HubSpot or Pipedrive setup, two-way sync with other tools, data migration

name: AI email and ticket triage
examples: sorting incoming emails or tickets, drafted replies, routing to the right person

name: AI assistant on company knowledge
examples: chatbot on website, Telegram or WhatsApp answering from company documents (RAG)

name: Document processing
examples: documents of completed transactions (placed online orders, invoices, receipts, contracts, filled forms) read automatically and pushed into a POS, ERP, accounting or other system

name: Automated reporting
examples: scheduled reports and summaries pulled from several tools

name: Custom multi-step AI agent
examples: multi-step agent or several agents working across systems
